name: npm-frontend
description: Foreign npm frontend in the Curie foreign-projects demo

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp src/index.js dist/index.js && echo 'npm-frontend: built'
scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const s=fs.readFileSync('src/index.js','utf8'); if(!s.includes('npm-frontend')) process.exit(1); console.log('npm-frontend: ok')"
